name: AWS Inf2.48xlarge: 2280 FP16 TFLOPS (12-chip instance)
methodology: Vendor-published instance specification. 12 Inferentia2 chips with NeuronLink-v2 at 192 GB/s/chip. Per-chip: 190 TFLOPS FP16, 32 GB HBM, 820 GB/s. Also: 570 TFLOPS FP32, 384 GB HBM, 9.8 TB/s aggregate bandwidth.
notes: Vendor-published peak compute specification. The 2280 TFLOPS is the theoretical FP16 peak for the 12-chip Inf2.48xlarge instance. No inference throughput (tokens/sec) is published by AWS for Inferentia2. The per-chip FP16 figure of 190 TFLOPS is directly from the vendor product page.
